title: PracticePay Patient Financing Late-Fee Level and Recent Late Fees
content:
**Rule.** On PracticePay Patient Financing, the late-fee level follows the plan's late-fee record: when the plan shows a late fee dated within the last 6 months, the late-fee level is 35.00 USD; when the plan shows no late fee dated within the last 12 months, the late-fee level is 20.00 USD; when the plan shows a late fee dated within the last 12 months but none within the last 6 months, the late-fee level is the plan's late fee of 27.00 USD; a window of the last N months here covering entries dated fewer than N whole months before the assessment date, a month being whole once the assessment date's day of the month has reached the entry's day of the month.

| Earlier late fees on the plan | Late-fee level |
|---|---|
| at least one within the last 6 months | 35.00 |
| one or more within the last 12 months, none within the last 6 months | 27.00 |
| none within the last 12 months | 20.00 |

## Window edges (hypothetical, assessment on 12 September)

| Most recent earlier late fee dated | Whole months back | Level |
|---|---|---|
| 13 March | 5 | 35.00 |
| 12 March | 6 | 27.00 |
| 13 September of the year before | 11 | 27.00 |
| 12 September of the year before | 12 | 20.00 |
